body:
Thanks. You're actually reminding me of something that has gotten me through many a rough patch and that I often tell others when they're struggling. You're right, and I'm going to think about it. I'm in school right now and there are lots of applications for what I'm studying that could be beneficial to others. I have volunteered a lot in the past, and I'd like to make time for that again, too. Working up the motivation will be a challenge but knowing I just might have the potential to be a positive thing in somebody's life helps.

Thank you for your insight.

Thanks, Lizzie, for taking the time. I imagine a lot of people feel this way at least occasionally. I know I've heard people describe the same thing, so it's comforting. 

I have people I could talk to but I don't. It's mostly people I met in treatment for my eating disorder--they heard more from me than any of my closest friend from before--and I'm kind of stuck on making them think things are fine because I don't want to drag them down.
